verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a developer suite for a public RESTful API with resource URIs queried by simple GETs, plus a get-started guide and dedicated Authorisation and Rate limiting guides on its own developer pages. A live probe confirms the API is real: an unauthenticated request returns a structured 401 auth challenge, consistent with a registered-key model. missing for 10: the actual rate-limit figures, concrete key-registration steps, and an endpoint reference listing are not quoted in the evidence; there is no independent developer corroboration.
